scope: repository-owned deterministic integration over caller-supplied records

guarantees: facility inputs are versioned, public-only and non-authoritative
distance, network, multimodal, capacity and competition measures remain explicit
deprivation, demographic and rurality context remains separate from access
health records are explicitly ecological and retain denominator, source and small-cell status
suppressed small-cell records cannot expose an outcome rate
spatial confounding, MAUP and measurement-error sensitivity records are required
planning rules are citation-digest bound and retain authority-required status
prohibited and unresolved candidates cannot enter the alternatives frontier
average, worst-case, subgroup, capacity, competition, cost and robustness metrics are all required
market, land, community and consent constraints remain outside the model
no preferred site or promotion decision is produced

negative_cases: declared planning status inconsistent with cited rules

remaining_gates: complete all five blocking dependency tracks
obtain rights-cleared versioned supermarket and population inputs
reproduce the motivating study or fully resolve empirical discrepancies
execute representative multimodal accessibility and facility reconciliation
link operative planning provisions and complete authority review
execute empirical ecological-health analyses under the causal-methods framework
run representative alternatives with externally reviewed assumptions
complete the required agent-panel and independent reproduction
build and preserve a complete research object
nonclaims: The contract does not acquire data, establish registry completeness, reproduce a study or estimate a health effect.
Fixture and caller-supplied records do not establish planning permission, consent certainty, commercial viability or a preferred location.
Repository validation is not independent reproduction, agent-panel qualification or publication approval.
